memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Coronary artery disease and obesity.
Patient reports occasional chest heaviness on climbing stairs and mild dyspnea while tailoring for long hours. On examination, blood pressure 138/84 mmHg, pulse 78/min regular, BMI 32.1 kg/m2, waist circumference 102 cm, lungs clear bilaterally, no cardiac murmurs. Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.2 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; no prior test for comparison. Smoking status: never. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: N/A.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Aspirin 75 mg OD
Atorvastatin 40 mg HS
Metoprolol succinate 25 mg OD
Isosorbide mononitrate 20 mg OD
Sublingual GTN SOS
Orlistat 120 mg with each main meal

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: LDL 138 mg/dL (ref <100), HDL 42 mg/dL (ref >40), TG 165 mg/dL (ref <150).
Fasting glucose: 98 mg/dL (ref 70-100).
HbA1c: 5.9% (ref 4-5.6).
Liver function: ALT 28 U/L (ref 7-35), AST 24 U/L (ref 8-33), ALP 78 U/L (ref 40-129), GGT 32 U/L (ref 9-36), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (ref 0.2-1.2).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: ECG: Sinus rhythm, rate 76 bpm. No ST‑segment depression or elevation. No pathological Q waves. Mild left ventricular voltage criteria for hypertrophy. No arrhythmias.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I feel a bit of tightness in my chest when I reach for the top shelf at work, and I get short of breath after walking to the market. My tailoring work involves long periods of standing.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Coronary artery disease and obesity – stable.
Patient denies angina at rest; reports occasional mild discomfort after brisk walk, relieved by rest. Blood pressure 136/82 mmHg, pulse 80/min, BMI 31.8 kg/m2, waist 100 cm. Lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (95% predicted), FVC 3.3 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.1 L since last visit. Smoking status: never. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: N/A.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Treadmill test (Bruce protocol): Exercise terminated at stage 3 due to fatigue, achieving 6.5 METs. No ST‑segment depression >1 mm, no chest pain. Heart rate peaked at 132 bpm. Blood pressure response normal. No arrhythmias.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Coronary artery disease and obesity – stable.
Patient notes reduced waist circumference after dietary changes; no angina, occasional mild dyspnea on exertion. Blood pressure 134/80 mmHg, pulse 78/min, BMI 31.2 kg/m2, waist 96 cm. Lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (96% predicted), FVC 3.3 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 0.0 L. Smoking status: never. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: N/A.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Coronary artery disease and obesity – stable with mild exertional dyspnea.
Patient reports occasional shortness of breath climbing two flights of stairs, relieved by rest. No chest pain. Blood pressure 132/78 mmHg, pulse 76/min, BMI 30.9 kg/m2, waist 94 cm. Lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 3.0 L (98% predicted), FVC 3.4 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.1 L. Smoking status: never. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: N/A.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Cardiology for evaluation of exertional dyspnea and optimization of coronary artery disease management. Request ECG, echocardiogram, and cardiology opinion on medical therapy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cardiology review: Echocardiogram shows LVEF 58%, mild left ventricular hypertrophy, no wall motion abnormalities. Exercise tolerance good. Recommend continuation of current medical therapy, add low‑dose ACE inhibitor if blood pressure tolerates. No intervention required.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked with Dr Suresh Menon (D05) on 2026-07-10 at 10:30 AM.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Coronary artery disease and obesity – stable.
Patient remains asymptomatic at rest, reports mild dyspnea only on vigorous activity. Blood pressure 130/76 mmHg, pulse 74/min, BMI 30.5 kg/m2, waist 92 cm. Lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 3.0 L (99% predicted), FVC 3.4 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 0.0 L. Smoking status: never. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: N/A. Plan: continue current medications, repeat lipid profile in 3 months, encourage weight‑loss goal.
